text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using my day off, I came to Bubbly Land to have
some fun. Just then, I spotted a young horse girl
looking around anxiously in the crowd.
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Are you lost?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
No... It's just there are so many... people. Nonstop.
I can't cross...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So this is where you were...! 
My apologies. Has my sister caused you any—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm, you're from the academy...
Well, regardless, you saved the day. You have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sister... So they came here to have fun together.
In that case, they'd probably want some private
sisterly bonding time.
choice_data_list: I'll take my leave then. Have fun!
I'll take my leave then. Have fun!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah... right. Pardon us. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly.
Didn't I tell you to be mindful of crowds?

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Second Daughter)
text_block_list.text:
Muu.
I was being careful, but I got surrounded...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haah... You need to pull yourself together
for Rin's sake too—

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Second Daughter)
text_block_list.text: ...Rin-chan isn't here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What!?
Where did she—

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Third Daughter)
text_block_list.text: Yahooooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Third Daughter)
text_block_list.text: Puh-haah!! That felt so goooood!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fool! Didn't I tell you not to wander off on your own!

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Third Daughter)
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Onee-chan... But, but!
You ran off to search for her out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I explicitly told you to stay put when I stepped away!
What would you have done if you started drowning all alone!
And furthermore—!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Seriously, you're so meticulous it's annoyin' as hell.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. Listen, okay?
I'm not saying you can't go.
Just make sure you get my permission first.

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Third Daughter)
text_block_list.text:
Eh... okay.
...Then, I'm going down the slide. Can I?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. Go down together this time.
I'll take a photo for you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tired? Here, have some orange juice.
You used to love ones with decorations like this, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, no. Perhaps you're already too old for that?

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Third Daughter)
text_block_list.text:
No, I still love it. Thanks.
............

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Do you remember our little
argument from before?
About that—

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Third Daughter)
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!!
I was the one in the wrong back then...!
Saying you were annoying and all...

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Third Daughter)
text_block_list.text:
That's why Onee-chan... is mad at me, right?
You've been acting different from usual...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How could I possibly be angry...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am the one who... backed you into a corner with my
interrogative tone. I am sorry.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However... To think you would offer
such a sincere apology on your own... You've truly grown.

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Third Daughter)
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, of course!
...After all, I grew up watching my Onee-chan.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Look at you, getting cheeky.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You will continue to grow
more and more from here on, won't you...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so... I will always be your elder sister.
If you ever face troubles, never hesitate to come to me.

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Second Daughter)
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! What were you guys talking about?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. It is best that I explain
everything to you from the beginning as well.
Listen closely. To me, you sisters are—

text_block_list.name: Groove's Sister (Third Daughter)
text_block_list.text:
Onee-chan, we already know without you saying it!
Now you're really gonna get called naggy, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from Bubbly Land.
I ended up on the same bus as Air Groove and her sisters.
The sisters appear to have fallen asleep from exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Expressing one's feelings directly...
really is for the best, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so... no matter how much time passes,
their sleeping faces never fail to look adorable.
